summary: Generator library (matrix-generator.ts) and CLI are well-designed with good TypeScript practices. CRITICAL GAPS: (1) Missing external act test harness—task requires a runner script that executes `act push` for each fixture, collects output to `act-result.txt`, validates exit codes and exact output values. This is not shown. (2) Workflow doesn't generate/collect act-result.txt (required artifact). (3) Fixture loop (lines 53–67) doesn't validate output or assert expected values; silently passes/fails. (4) No explicit `shell: bash` or `set -euo pipefail` in workflow bash steps; poor error handling. (5) Fixture files and test fixtures not provided. Task explicitly mandates: "All tests must execute through... act", "assert EXACT EXPECTED VALUES", "act-result.txt file MUST exist when done." Workflow generates matrices but lacks the validation harness required to ship. Would NOT deploy: incomplete CI/CD implementation.
